Meet Gemini 4 Hydrogen: built for rapid coding, multimodal synthesis, and everyday workflows. It finishes tasks 2.5x faster than 3.8 Flash and surpasses Argon on the @ArtificialAnlys Intelligence Index.
items.title_zh: 认识 Gemini 4 Hydrogen：专为快速编码、多模态合成和日常工作流而打造。它完成任务的速度比 3.8 Flash 快 2.5 倍，并在 @ArtificialAnlys 智能指数上超越 Argon。

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 is here. 🤖 Our latest physical AI is able to learn hundreds of everyday skills - from folding laundry and serving pastries to autonomously sorting car parts on the factory floor. Here’s a snapshot of its capabilities 🧵
items.title_zh: Gemini Robotics 2.5 来了。🤖 我们最新的物理 AI 能够学习数百项日常技能——从叠衣服、端糕点，到在工厂车间自主分拣汽车零件。以下是其能力概览 🧵

items.title: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work. Muse Ember can carry workflows across apps, call tools in sequence, run tests and make targeted code fixes. With a 1M-token context window
items.title_zh: 今天我们推出 Muse Ember，这是我们最小、最高效的模型，专为复杂推理执行和日常智能体工作而打造。Muse Ember 可以跨应用承载工作流、按顺序调用工具、运行测试并进行有针对性的代码修复。拥有 100 万 token 的上下文窗口

items.title: Your heart, brain, and immune system share the same DNA sequence. So how can a single-letter change affect disease in some cells, while sparing the rest? AlphaGenome 2 is our new AI model that zooms in on specific cells to help scientists understand what drives disease. 🧵
items.title_zh: 你的心脏、大脑和免疫系统共享同一 DNA 序列。那么，单个字母的变化为何能影响某些细胞中的疾病，而不影响其余细胞？AlphaGenome 2 是我们的新 AI 模型，可聚焦特定细胞，帮助科学家理解疾病的驱动因素。🧵

items.title: For the first time, AI has mathematically proven @signalapp’s protocol is secure down to the code level. Using our breakthrough AlphaProof Code framework, we verified the messaging app’s cryptographic system – which protects billions of private messages every day.
items.title_zh: AI 首次从数学上证明了 @signalapp 的协议在代码层面是安全的。借助我们突破性的 AlphaProof Code 框架，我们验证了这款消息应用的密码系统——它每天保护着数十亿条私人消息。

items.title: Start building with Gemini 4 Carbon: our strongest model for complex, long-horizon tasks. It’s designed to explore problems thoroughly and run extended verification loops across software engineering, cybersecurity, knowledge work, and science.
items.title_zh: 开始使用 Gemini 4 Carbon 构建：这是我们处理复杂、长周期任务的最强模型。它旨在深入探索问题，并在软件工程、网络安全、知识工作和科学领域运行扩展验证循环。

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available in Perplexity Computer for Pro and Max subscribers, and in Search for Max subscribers. It scores 0.857 on our WANDR benchmark at $5.86 per task, matching Claude Fable 5.2 at 40% of the cost.
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 现已在 Perplexity Computer 中向 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户开放，并在 Search 中向 Max 订阅用户开放。它在我们的 WANDR 基准测试中得分为 0.857，每任务成本 5.86 美元，以 40% 的成本匹配 Claude Fable 5.2。

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 is now available in Perplexity Computer for Pro and Max subscribers, and in Search for Max subscribers. On our WANDR benchmark, it achieved Pareto frontier of performance and efficiency, with a record score of 0.851 at $14.51 per task.
items.title_zh: Claude Fable 5.2 现已在 Perplexity Computer 中向 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户开放，并在 Search 中向 Max 订阅用户开放。在我们的 WANDR 基准测试中，它达到了性能与效率的帕累托前沿，以每任务 14.51 美元创下 0.851 的纪录得分。

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon helped build Gemini Robotics 2.5, speeding up months of training. It creates virtual practice spaces from a single camera view, and watches replays of its own mistakes to fix its technique, driving stronger performance on the real robot.
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 帮助构建了 Gemini Robotics 2.5，加速了数月的训练。它从单一摄像头视角创建虚拟练习空间，并观看自身错误的回放来修正技术，从而在真实机器人上实现更强的性能。

items.title: In a proof of concept with @Apptronik and @MercedesBenz Gemini Robotic 2.5 helped the Apollo 2 robot pick and organize car parts for assembly with 96% accuracy.
items.title_zh: 在与 @Apptronik 和 @MercedesBenz 的概念验证中，Gemini Robotic 2.5 帮助 Apollo 2 机器人以 96% 的准确率挑选并整理用于装配的汽车零件。
